div.div:
a person also modify/temper the document and calculate new hash signature of that document and then add that new hash in that document.
This where the concept of public and private key comes in, now we have even encrypt the hash of the document also using private key, then that hash can only decrypted using public key, and if the hash is decrypt successfully, this will prove that the hash is not modified(incase if the encrypted hash is modified then the public key won,t be able to decrypt the encrypted hash, thus proving the temperness in the encrypted hash), and now once we have the authentic hash, we also correctly verify document hash with this decrypted hash after independently calculating the hash of the document also

text.tspan: a person also modify/temper the document and calculate new hash signature of that document and
then add that new hash in that document.
This where the concept of public and private key comes in, now we have even encrypt the hash of the
document also using private key, then that hash can only decrypted using public key, and if the hash is
decrypt successfully, this will prove that the hash is not modified(incase if the encrypted hash is
modified then the public key won,t be able to decrypt the encrypted hash, thus proving the temperness
in the encrypted hash), and now once we have the authentic hash, we also correctly verify document
hash with this decrypted hash after independently calculating the hash of the document also
